description: 5₂ complex volume 𝔙(5₂)=Vol+iCS via the Neumann–Zagier saddle (Hikami 0604094 §4.2, eq 4.13), deformed to the substrate meridian m=q₀ at both anchors. Validates Vol(5₂)=2.82812 at m=1. THE TEST (Step 1): the anchor-DEPENDENT quantum volume is the one object the Lean-proved no_anchor_invariant_realizes_swing does not exclude — is its cross-anchor swing the ~3.84e6-sensitive quantity N_odd=S·u³ needs? Measured max |d𝔙/dq| vs the 3.84e6 target. 5₂ is chiral (Re 𝔙 = CS-partner ≠ 0, unlike amphichiral 4₁). No c_k; no fit; scope-(a). Corpus CS(5₂)≈−0.153π² is a proposed target, not a derivation — reported for contrast, not wired.

data.swing_target: N_odd=S·u³ needs d/dq ~ 3.84e6 (the 1/u³-amplified smooth-numerator slope); a classical/quantum invariant smooth in q₀ gives O(1)–O(10) slope.
data.verdict: 5₂ QUANTUM VOLUME COMPUTED + Vol VALIDATED (2.82812). The anchor-dependent 𝔙_q(5₂) has max |d𝔙/dq| = 1.473e+00 — ANCHOR-SMOOTH (O(1) slope), ~6 orders below the 3.84e6 the S-swing needs. 5₂ is chiral (Re 𝔙 ≠ 0), so it IS the nonzero bar-odd/CS home 4₁ lacks, and being anchor-dependent it is not excluded by the prune — but its smooth q₀-dependence still cannot supply the 2e6-amplified swing; the swing remains the 1/u³ inversion of a smooth numerator (BarOddLadderShape), pinned by experimental Q_β. No c_k; no fit; scope-(a).
